risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively detailed on revenue, margins, earnings, segment performance, and backlog, but includes substantial standard forward-looking disclaimers and judgment-based backlog recognition. Operating results weakened materially year over year, while backlog growth and favorable power-market conditions provide a cautiously constructive outlook; project delays, cancellations, and exposure to large power projects remain key risks.
